thag6.8:2.1: niyyāniko uttaraṇo taṇhāmūlavisosano, visamūlaṃ āghātanaṃ chetvā pāpeti nibbutiṃ, || ||
thag6.8:4.1: vedanānaṃ viññāpano upādānappamocano bhavaṃ aṅgārakāsuṃ va ñāṇena anupassako || ||
thag6.8:5.1: mahāraso sugambhīro jarāmaccunivāraṇo ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo dukkhūpasamano sivo || ||
thag6.8:6.1: kammaṃ kamman ti ñatvāna vipākañ ca vipākato paṭiccuppannadhammānaṃ yathāvālokadassano mahākhemaṃgamo santo pariyosānabhaddako 'ti. || || Migajālo thero.
